This '''mission''' took place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] when [[Jahan Cross]] and [[IN-GA 44]] traveled to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] to investigate [[Rossum Droidworks]] and the [[Stark family]] in regards to the [[Iron Eclipse]] project.
